settings.label: Source script URLs
settings.help: One or more LX Music custom source .js links, separated by new lines. Commas or semicolons only split when another link follows. Every source is asked at once when a song plays, and the fastest answer plays.

settings.label: Source script (pasted)
settings.help: Optional. Paste a script here and it joins the ones above.

settings.label: Catalog
settings.help: wy, tx, or leave it empty for both. These are source keys, not catalog names; the choice covers search and the discovery pages.

settings.label: Catalog browsing
settings.help: on or off. Turn it off to hide charts, playlists, daily picks, synced lists and the account menu, leaving search and the source adapter.

settings.label: Sync credential (optional)
settings.help: Only needed when a sign-in window is unavailable. Paste the cookie of your own signed-in web session; it stays on this device and is used just to read your own lists.
